subject_instruction:
This text is a social media post. Identify each substantive point the user communicates. Summarize every independent point as a separate, concise takeaway in your own words. Combine details when they jointly express one point. Ground each takeaway in the text itself.

Return only a JSON array of strings.
mask_instruction:
Mask only the narrowest portion or portions of the provided text that directly express the provided takeaway.

Takeaway:
<TAKEAWAY>

Text:
<RAW NOTE>

Return only a JSON array of exact substrings copied from the text, in source order. If the takeaway is not expressed, return "unsupported".
